title: Enigma · M01/P39 rotor-frame base fit trial
material: Bambu PLA Basic · black · AMS A3

snapshots.caption: Immediately after printer acceptance: PREPARE, empty bed before deposition. This is not a finished-part image.
After user inspection and resume: matching job RUNNING at 6%, no reported print error. Deposited perimeter/brim visible; not a finished-part or fit inspection.

notes: One support-free PLA base; 4 walls, 30% gyroid, 8 mm outer brim, textured PEI, leveling and flow calibration on; timelapse off. Exact reviewed uploaded file downloaded and SHA-256 verified. Device returned project_file SUCCESS with matching MD5, file and plate 1; fresh telemetry PREPARE, print_error 0. Unloaded mounting/fastener/alignment trial only; fit and mechanism operation unverified. User explicitly directed printing before website publication; live-guide mismatch retained as an explicit exception, all source/geometry/slice/material/readback checks retained. Completion time and actual usage pending. Subsequent fresh telemetry confirmed PAUSE at 3% on layer 1, print_error 0300-800C (multiple motion step loss); printer reports 163 minutes remaining if resumed. Not resumed: physical obstruction/noise inspection requested. Cause and print quality are unconfirmed. User reports no obstruction or abnormal noise and that printing resumed. Subsequent fresh telemetry confirms same job RUNNING at 6%, print_error 0, estimated remaining 156 minutes. Camera shows deposited perimeter/brim and active toolhead; adhesion, dimensional accuracy and fit remain unverified.
